scientific_integrity: Proof identifies exact quantifiers, eigenvalue normalization, quotient phase capacities, all extremizers and their label multiplicities. A self-contained finite cross-check is supplied. A prior unindexed equivalent statement is possible; the classical geometric-sum identity is not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Two unweighted rows of an N-point cyclic Fourier matrix, for \(N\ge3\) and distinct character frequencies. The result does not treat higher-rank Fourier submatrices, arbitrary dual decoding, or unequal weights. The finite checker is not a proof for infinite parameter families.
title: Exact adversarial-erasure spectra for two-character cyclic harmonic frames
